policy: Reviewed, time-limited exceptions to the high-severity dependency audit gate. An exception records a deliberate decision that a specific advisory does not apply to how Wingman uses the package. It is not a way to silence a finding that has not been assessed. Every entry must carry a justification and an expiry; the check fails once an exception expires, so nothing here can quietly become permanent.

exceptions.title: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
exceptions.justification: The vulnerability is specific to React Router's RSC (React Server Components) mode, where an action can execute before a 400 response is returned. Wingman is an entirely client-rendered SPA: it mounts BrowserRouter in src/main.tsx, has no server-side rendering and no RSC entry point, and does not import any RSC or static-handler API from react-router. The vulnerable code path is therefore not reachable in this application.
exceptions.verification: Confirmed no RSC usage by searching src/ for RSC, createStaticHandler and renderToPipeableStream - no matches. Wingman renders via createRoot in src/main.tsx.
exceptions.remediationBlocked: The patched react-router release is 8.3.0, but the latest available react-router-dom release is 7.18.2 and declares an exact dependency on react-router 7.18.2. Forcing router 8.3.0 through an override would create an unsupported mixed-major installation; npm's automated downgrade path would undo the deliberate 6.x -> 7.x upgrade applied in PR #115. Wingman is pinned to the latest compatible DOM/router pair while this upstream release gap remains.
exceptions.reviewAction: Before expiry, re-check for a react-router-dom release that officially depends on patched react-router. Upgrade the pair together and delete this exception; do not force a mixed-major override.

exceptions.title: brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
exceptions.justification: The affected brace-expansion instances are present exclusively through Wingman's development-time ESLint and TypeScript-ESLint tooling. ESLint, minimatch and brace-expansion are not included in the deployed Wingman browser application. Wingman does not pass customer-controlled brace or glob expressions into this development tooling.
exceptions.verification: npm explain brace-expansion confirms that brace-expansion is reached through minimatch, ESLint, ESLint plugins and TypeScript-ESLint development dependencies. TypeScript validation, the Vite production build, 723 tests and the full Wingman verification suite pass. The production bundle does not contain the ESLint toolchain.
exceptions.remediationBlocked: The advisory is patched in brace-expansion 5.0.8, but the remaining legacy ESLint dependency path uses minimatch 3.1.5 with brace-expansion ^1.1.7. No patched compatible 1.x brace-expansion release is currently available. Forcing version 5 beneath minimatch 3 would cross major versions and has not been validated.
exceptions.reviewAction: Before expiry, update the compatible brace-expansion 5.x dependency path to 5.0.8 and check whether ESLint or its plugins have moved away from minimatch 3. Remove this exception once every installed path resolves to a patched version.
